content:
Below is an interesting map shows presence of Muslims in China. Turkic (Uyghur) Muslims mostly live in autonomous region – Xinjiang, the most western border of present day China. Hui Muslims are mostly Chinese Muslims live in Mainland China. Their presence depicted as triangles.
The Map is from Aramco Magazine 1985, you can see USSR still existed at that time. The map shows famous Silk Road and the Great Wall of China.

#AbusheikMuhammed
